verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Department of State publishes fees, the paper and online filing options, expedite tiers and card-payment paperwork. Nothing in the pack says which account, login credential or identity-proofing steps are required before filing online. The filing application host could not be reached, so any account wall it has was neither documented nor observed.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
